title: AgriNova AI - Ubumenyi bw'ubuhinzi bushingiye kuri RAB
notice: Iyi ni intangiriro y'ubumenyi. Ntisimbura amabwiriza yihariye y'umurima. Ntugahimbe ibipimo by'ifumbire, imiti, intera yo gutera cyangwa igihe cyo gutera.

sources.organization: Rwanda Agriculture and Animal Resources Development Board (RAB)
sources.title: Crop Innovation and Technology Transfer
facts: RAB ihuza ubushakashatsi ku bihingwa no kugeza ikoranabuhanga ku bahinzi.
RAB ikorana n'abakozi bashinzwe ubujyanama bw'ubuhinzi, abahugura abahinzi n'abafashamyumvire bo mu matsinda y'abahinzi.
RAB itegura inyandiko z'ubujyanama kandi igahugura abahinzi ku buhinzi bwiza.

sources.title: Cereals Program
facts: Porogaramu y'ibinyampeke ya RAB ikora ubushakashatsi ku bigori, umuceri, ingano, barley n'amasaka.
Ubushakashatsi ku bigori bwibanda no ku kwihanganira amapfa, Fall Armyworm, Maize Lethal Necrosis n'indwara zimwe zo ku mababi.
sources.limits: Ibyibandwaho mu bushakashatsi si amabwiriza yo gukoresha umuti cyangwa ifumbire mu murima runaka.

sources.title: Pulses and Oil Crops Program
facts: RAB ikora ubushakashatsi ku bwoko bw'ibishyimbo, soya, amashaza, ubunyobwa n'izuba.
Intego z'ubushakashatsi zirimo kongera umusaruro, kwera hakiri kare, kwihanganira indwara n'udukoko no kunoza intungamubiri.

sources.title: Roots and Tubers Program
facts: RAB ikora ubushakashatsi no kugeza ikoranabuhanga ku bahinzi b'imyumbati, ibirayi n'ibijumba.
Ibikorwa by'iyi porogaramu birimo ubwoko bushya, guhangana n'indwara n'udukoko, uburyo bwiza bwo kwita ku bihingwa, imbuto z'indobanure, kubika umusaruro no kongera agaciro kawo.

sources.title: Horticulture Program
facts: RAB ifite porogaramu y'ubushakashatsi no gukwirakwiza ikoranabuhanga ku bihingwa by'imboga n'imbuto.
sources.limits: Iyi nyandiko rusange ntitanga ibipimo by'ifumbire cyangwa gahunda yo gutera kuri buri gihingwa.

sources.title: Crop Protection Program
facts: RAB ikurikirana indwara n'udukoko byibasira ibihingwa by'ingenzi.
RAB ihugura abakozi b'ubujyanama bw'ubuhinzi kandi ikora ingendo zo gusura imirima.
Kumenya neza ikibazo no kugikurikirana ni ingenzi mbere yo guhitamo uburyo bwo kukirwanya.

sources.title: Rwanda Digital Soil Information System (RwaSIS)
facts: RwaSIS itanga amakuru ajyanye n'imiterere y'ubutaka, ibihingwa bibukwiriye, ibyago by'isuri n'inama ku ifumbire na lime.
Inama y'ifumbire igomba gushingira ku makuru y'ubutaka bw'ahantu runaka; ntibikwiye gutanga igipimo kimwe ku butaka bwose.
RAB yavuze ko igihe yatangazaga amakuru yo gutangiza RwaSIS, ibizamini bimwe by'ibigori, ingano, imyumbati n'ibishyimbo byari bikiri gukorwa, mu gihe iby'ibirayi n'umuceri byari byarangiye.

sources.title: RAB Annual Report 2023-2024
facts: Raporo ivuga ku mahugurwa yo kumenya no gukurikirana Fall Armyworm, Integrated Pest Management no gukoresha imiti mu buryo butekanye.
sources.limits: Raporo ni iy'umwaka wa 2023-2024; ntigomba kwitiranywa n'amabwiriza mashya ya 2026.

assistant_rules: Tandukanya ibimenyetso bigaragara, ibyo umuhinzi yavuze n'indwara zikekwa.
Ntukemeze indwara ukoresheje ifoto imwe gusa.
Ntuhimbe amazina y'imiti, ingano yayo, ibipimo by'ifumbire cyangwa intera yo gutera.
Ku kibazo gisaba amakuru y'ubutaka, saba amakuru y'aho umurima uri cyangwa koresha RwaSIS aho bishoboka.
Vuga umwaka w'inyandiko cyangwa imibare igihe ari ingenzi.
Baza ikibazo kimwe cy'ingenzi igihe amakuru adahagije.
Ku kibazo gikomeye cyangwa gikomeje gukwira, ohereza umuhinzi ku muhinzi-mworozi w'umwuga cyangwa RAB.
